review: Late packets l and m: semantic novelty screen

scope.prototype_coverage: All l report snippets and all three l standalone experiments; all five m standalone experiments, SignedModEq module, optional PermutationClients and optional patch; exact changed declaration regions in complete replacement/proposed modules; both main patches (a combined display truncated part of m, but all changed m declaration regions were subsequently read separately).
scope.method: Static reading of already-extracted public repository objects, semantic comparison of statements and actual changed proof mechanisms. Complete-file copies were not automatically counted as proposals.
scope.execution: No Lean, TeX, repository scripts, builds, installs, new fetches, or upstream edits performed. Shell was used only for local file listing and text inspection; apply_patch creates this review ledger only.
scope.report_locator_convention: Exact source-line locators and report section titles are supplied. PDF page numbers have not been independently extracted; do not invent PDF pagination from source positions.
scope.prior_validation_claims: The packets report successful pinned Lean validation for main edits, but this review has not rerun it. m's optional complete WangTiles942 client is explicitly uncompiled in its own report.

assumed_baseline_mechanisms.title: Finite forward invariance implies predecessor invariance
assumed_baseline_mechanisms.report: 2026-10-26l/report/report.tex:498-555, section 8 Idea 6: use inverse invariance of a finite set
assumed_baseline_mechanisms.distinctive_text: The restriction of an injective map to the finite set E is surjective.
assumed_baseline_mechanisms.mechanism: Show even S is forward invariant; use Equiv.Perm.perm_symm_on_of_perm_on_finite to prove the predecessor of a hypothetical 510 state is even; successor_mod_four then contradicts 510 mod 4. Deletes iterate induction, positive period, p-1 arithmetic. Preserves finite type and allowed 511 self-loop.
assumed_baseline_mechanisms.followup_already_suggested: report.tex:636-642 expressly generalizes the search to any finite-permutation proof whose period witness only returns a forward-invariant property to a predecessor.
assumed_baseline_mechanisms.rank_search_boundary: Do not advertise finite invariant-predicate backward transport as new in CurrentCellConstruction2011 or NativeRankVariation merely because its predicate or constants differ. A genuinely different mathematical invariant/endpoint would need a specific argument for novelty.

assumed_baseline_mechanisms.title: Small-ordinate Pell fundamentality criterion
assumed_baseline_mechanisms.report: 2026-10-26m/report/additional_lean_simplifications.tex:283-369, section 3 A uniform small-ordinate criterion for Pell minimality
assumed_baseline_mechanisms.mechanism: For any Pell solution with x > 1 and 0 < y <= 3, classify as f^n for a fundamental f; n >= 2 implies y >= 2*f.x*f.y >= 4, contradiction. Apply to (2Q+1,2), replacing discriminant-specific ordinate case analysis. Threshold sharp by (7,4) at d=3.
assumed_baseline_mechanisms.followup_already_suggested: report:832-840 proposes stronger lower bounds or discriminant-dependent thresholds and actual other minimality consumers.

additional_exclusion_notes.item: Canonical semiring relational witness for ObjectNaturalSemiring.evalRel_iff was developed and excluded because prior notes already suggested evaluator totality witness. Not a new l contribution; remains assumed prior work. An unused constructor-algebra design was not delivered.

Both reports list older exclusions such as assignment transport, witness layouts, scanners, Boolean outputs, coefficient envelopes and source records. This bounded review does not re-establish those older packets; parent catalog owns them.

Complete NativePellBootstrap replacement copies include nativeRank and numerous source_* declarations that neither l nor m changes. Presence in a copied full module is not evidence those declarations or all adjacent proof strategies were proposed. The actual l edit is coordinates_mono_base/main_index_gt_first; m edit is small-ordinate fundamentality.

bottom_line: l/m add no duplicate of the three surviving round3 ideas. They expand assumed baseline with the exact mechanisms above; L2 and m odd-index reuse are exact duplicates, and m SignedModEq subsumes l's local sign-transport direction. For CurrentCellConstruction2011/NativeRankVariation, especially exclude already-proposed finite predecessor invariance and the zero-head/positive-tail injectivity packaging, but do not conflate unchanged copied rank source with new proposals.
